newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS - More rolling out of Coca-Cola.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS - More rolling out of Coca-Cola.

text.p: Investors continued to exit positions in expiring Coca-Cola Co options Monday, with a large roll seen in the January 30 calls.
The January 30 calls traded 11,650 contracts by afternoon. The option had the highest open interest -- about 18,800 contracts through last Friday -- of any Coca-Cola option.
"It was just a roll," a trader at the Chicago Board Options Exchange said.
He said Goldman Sachs did the roll.
Coca-Cola shares were unchanged at 54-1/8 on consolidated volume of about 1.87 million shares in afternoon trading.
Last Thursday, Coca-Cola January 30 call and January 1998 30 call each traded more than 5,400 contracts in what also appeared to be a rolling out of the expiring contract.
January options expire at the end of this week.
On Monday, few other Coca-Cola options were busy.
